paragraphs: Banks in Ireland said yes to 5,265 home loans in October. A home loan to buy a house is called a mortgage. The figures come from a banking group.
The loans were worth about €1.7 billion in total. That is 10.3% more than in October last year. But it is 2% less than in September.
First-time buyers are people buying their first home. They were approved for 3,077 of the loans, almost six in ten. Their loans were worth just over €1 billion.
From January to October, banks approved 49,213 mortgages. This is the highest number for these months since 2011. Brian Hayes leads the banking group BPFI. He said the numbers keep growing.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭的銀行在十月同意了5,265筆住房貸款。
用來買房子的住房貸款叫做房貸。
這些數字來自一個銀行業團體。
這些貸款總共價值約17億歐元。
這比去年十月多了10.3%。
但比九月少了2%。
首購族是指買第一間房子的人。
他們獲准其中3,077筆貸款，將近十分之六。
他們的貸款價值略高於10億歐元。
從一月到十月，銀行核准了49,213筆房貸。
這是自2011年以來這幾個月的最高數字。
布萊恩・海斯是銀行業團體BPFI的負責人。
他說數字持續成長。

paragraphs: Banks and other lenders in Ireland approved about €1.7 billion in mortgages in October, according to new figures from the Banking and Payments Federation Ireland (BPFI). A mortgage approval is an official offer of a loan to buy a particular home.
There were 5,265 approvals in the month. First-time buyers got 3,077 of them, or 58.4%. The value of their loans went up by 8.5% compared with October last year, to just over €1 billion.
The total value of approvals was 2% lower than in September, but it was 10.3% higher than a year earlier.

Between January and October, there were 49,213 approvals, an increase of 8.1%. Their value rose by 10.9% to more than €16 billion. These are the highest figures for this period since the records began in 2011.

Brian Hayes, the head of the BPFI, said approvals kept growing in October and that first-time buyers made up almost six in ten of them. Between January and October, the value of mortgage approvals for people moving to a new home also rose by 7.5%, to more than €3.5 billion.
sentZh: 根據愛爾蘭銀行與支付聯合會（BPFI）的最新數據，愛爾蘭的銀行和其他放款機構在十月核准了約17億歐元的房貸。
房貸核准是指正式提供一筆貸款，用來購買某一間特定的房子。
當月共有5,265筆核准。
首購族拿到其中3,077筆，占58.4%。
他們的貸款金額比去年十月增加了8.5%，略高於10億歐元。
核准總金額比九月低了2%，但比一年前高了10.3%。
從一月到十月，共有49,213筆核准，增加了8.1%。
核准金額上升了10.9%，超過160億歐元。
這是自2011年開始有紀錄以來，這段期間的最高數字。
BPFI負責人布萊恩・海斯說，十月的核准數持續成長，首購族占了將近六成。
一月至十月換屋者的房貸核准金額也上升了7.5%，超過35億歐元。

paragraphs: Around €1.7 billion worth of mortgages were approved in October, according to the latest report from the Banking and Payments Federation Ireland (BPFI). An approval is a formal offer of finance from a lender for a specific residential property.

A total of 5,265 mortgages were approved during the month, with first-time buyers accounting for 3,077, or 58.4%. By value, first-time buyers made up 59.6% of the total and movers 21.9%. The value of first-time buyer approvals rose by 8.5% year-on-year to just over €1 billion.
Overall, the value of approvals fell by 2% compared with September but was 10.3% higher than in October 2025.

In the first ten months of the year, 49,213 mortgages were approved, up 8.1%, while their value climbed 10.9% to more than €16 billion. According to BPFI chief executive Brian Hayes, both figures are the highest for that period since the series began in 2011.

First-time buyers secured 29,314 approvals between January and October, a record for the period, worth over €9.7 billion. Meanwhile, the value of approvals for movers rose 7.5% to more than €3.5 billion.
sentZh: 根據愛爾蘭銀行與支付聯合會（BPFI）的最新報告，十月核准的房貸總值約17億歐元。
所謂核准，是指放款機構針對某一特定住宅物業正式提供融資。
當月共核准5,265筆房貸，其中首購族占3,077筆，即58.4%。
以金額計，首購族占總額的59.6%，換屋者占21.9%。
首購族的核准金額年增8.5%，略高於10億歐元。
整體而言，核准金額比九月下降2%，但比2025年十月高出10.3%。
今年前十個月共核准49,213筆房貸，增加8.1%，金額則攀升10.9%至超過160億歐元。
BPFI執行長布萊恩・海斯表示，這兩個數字都是自2011年開始統計以來同期的最高紀錄。
首購族在一月至十月間獲得29,314筆核准，創下同期紀錄，總值逾97億歐元。
與此同時，換屋者的核准金額上升7.5%，超過35億歐元。

paragraphs: Lenders sanctioned roughly €1.7 billion in mortgages in October, according to the latest data from the Banking and Payments Federation Ireland (BPFI). An approval constitutes a formal offer of finance from a lender for a particular residential property.

Some 5,265 mortgages were approved over the month, with first-time buyers accounting for 3,077, or 58.4% of the total. In value terms, first-time buyers represented 59.6% of the market and movers 21.9%. The value of first-time buyer approvals climbed 8.5% year-on-year to just over €1 billion.
Although the overall value of approvals dipped by 2% on September, it was up a robust 10.3% on the same month last year.

Over the first ten months of 2026, approvals rose 8.1% to 49,213, while their value surged 10.9% to in excess of €16 billion. BPFI chief executive Brian Hayes noted that both figures are the highest for the period since records commenced in 2011.
First-time buyers secured an unprecedented 29,314 approvals during that timeframe, worth upwards of €9.7 billion, underscoring their growing weight in the market.
sentZh: 根據愛爾蘭銀行與支付聯合會（BPFI）的最新數據，放款機構十月核准了約17億歐元的房貸。
核准即放款機構針對某一特定住宅物業提出的正式融資要約。
當月約有5,265筆房貸獲得核准，其中首購族占3,077筆，即總數的58.4%。
以金額而言，首購族占市場的59.6%，換屋者占21.9%。
首購族的核准金額年增8.5%，略高於10億歐元。
雖然整體核准金額比九月小幅下滑2%，但比去年同月強勁成長10.3%。
2026年前十個月，核准數上升8.1%至49,213筆，金額則激增10.9%至逾160億歐元。
BPFI執行長布萊恩・海斯指出，這兩個數字都是自2011年開始記錄以來同期的最高水準。
首購族在這段期間獲得史無前例的29,314筆核准，總值超過97億歐元，凸顯他們在市場中日益增加的分量。

paragraphs: According to the most recent data published by the Banking and Payments Federation Ireland (BPFI), approximately €1.7 billion in mortgages were approved in October. An approval represents a formal offer of finance from a lender in respect of a specific residential property.

In total, 5,265 mortgages were approved during the month, of which first-time buyers accounted for 3,077, or 58.4%. In terms of value, first-time buyers comprised 59.6% of the total, while movers constituted 21.9%. The value of first-time buyer approvals increased by 8.5% year-on-year to slightly more than €1 billion.
Although the aggregate value of approvals declined by 2% relative to September, it was 10.3% higher than in the corresponding month of the previous year.

Between January and October, the number of approvals rose by 8.1% to 49,213, and their value increased by 10.9% to over €16 billion. The BPFI's chief executive, Brian Hayes, observed that both figures were the highest recorded for this period since the series commenced in 2011.
Notably, first-time buyers obtained 29,314 approvals during this period, a record figure, with a combined value exceeding €9.7 billion.

paragraphs: Around €1.7 billion worth of mortgages were approved in October, according to the latest report from the Banking and Payments Federation Ireland (BPFI). An approval is a formal offer of finance from a lender for a specific residential property.

A total of 5,265 mortgages were approved during the month, with first-time buyers accounting for 3,077, or 58.4%. By value, first-time buyers made up 59.6% of the total and movers 21.9%. The value of first-time buyer approvals rose by 8.5% year-on-year to just over €1 billion.
Overall, the value of approvals fell by 2% compared with September but was 10.3% higher than in October 2025.

In the first ten months of the year, 49,213 mortgages were approved, up 8.1%, while their value climbed 10.9% to more than €16 billion. According to BPFI chief executive Brian Hayes, both figures are the highest for that period since the series began in 2011.

First-time buyers secured 29,314 approvals between January and October, a record for the period, worth over €9.7 billion. Meanwhile, the value of approvals for movers rose 7.5% to more than €3.5 billion.
